rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, decision, or action that is harsh, cruel, or refuses to relent.

example.english: They are truly ruthless in business, even going after their own friends.
example.traditional: 佢做生意真係好狠，連老友都照樣落手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 zan1 hai6 hou2 han2 lin4 lou5 jau5 dou1 ziu3 joeng6 lok6 sau2

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on showing no pity or compassion, rather than simply being tough or determined.

example.english: The boss was ruthless, firing an employee even when they were so ill.
example.traditional: 個老闆見到員工病到咁，都仲要炒佢，真係無情。
example.jyutping: go3 lou5 baan2 gin3 dou2 jyun4 gung1 beng6 dou3 gam3 dou1 zung6 jiu3 caau2 keoi5 zan1 hai6 mou4 cing4

rows.note: Use this especially when someone shows no mercy toward a particular person or opponent and will not ease off.

example.english: In the final, our opponents were ruthless toward us from start to finish.
example.traditional: 決賽嗰場，對手由頭到尾都對我哋唔留情。
example.jyutping: kyut3 coi3 go2 coeng4 deoi3 sau2 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 m4 lau4 cing4
